NEW TO THE GAME?

WHAT IT IS & HOW TO PLAY

What is Hellraiser: Revival?

A single-player horror adventure set in Clive Barker’s universe. As Aidan, you search for Sunny through the Labyrinth — mixing earthly weapons with the supernatural Genesis Configuration. Developed by Boss Team Games, published by Saber Interactive, available on PC and PS5.

How do you play?

Follow named objectives, explore rooms for codes, keys and recipes, solve puzzle boxes and keep manual saves in separate slots — there is no chapter select. The beginner’s guide walks through the first hours step by step.
